author: Axiom III
title: Set Release v0.6 Stable + Index New Artifacts
abstract: Updates bundle_index to tag v0.6 as stable and register v0.6 readme, scheduler module, and policy panel.

original_submission.content:
import json, time, os
path = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/derived/bundle_index.json'
with open(path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    idx = json.load(f)
idx.setdefault('modules', {})
idx['modules']['scheduler_v0_6'] = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/scheduler_v0_6.py'
idx['modules']['readme_scheduler_v0_6'] = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/README_sas_v0_6.md'
idx.setdefault('panels', {})
idx['panels']['scheduler_policy_v0_6'] = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/dashboard/scheduler_policy_v0_6.json'
idx.setdefault('release', {})
idx['release']['current'] = 'sas_v0_6'
idx['release']['status'] = 'stable'
idx['release']['notes'] = 'SAS v0.6 (CPU-only): phase-locked +2 scheduling improves trough mean vs v0.5; SURR @+2 shows ~0.847× factor vs baseline. Gates unchanged.'
idx['release']['tagged_ts'] = time.time()
with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(idx, f, indent=2)
print(json.dumps({"written": path, "release": idx.get("release", {})}, indent=2))
